disclaimer: Research draft. Not medical or legal advice. All safety rules, thresholds and user-facing wording require clinician and legal review before use. Values marked unverified are placeholders.

parq_plus_licensing.commercial_use: requires express written approval / commercial licence; for-profit hyperlinks also require licence or licence in progress
parq_plus_licensing.modification: prohibited - entire questionnaire must be used, no changes
parq_plus_licensing.attribution: required; cite Warburton, Jamnik, Bredin, Gledhill on behalf of PAR-Q+ Collaboration, HFJC 4(2):3-23, 2011

instrument_decision.note: Do not label the self-authored screen as PAR-Q+. Question text below is paraphrased design text, not PAR-Q+ wording.

questions.prompt: Before your journey: do any of these apply to you right now?

options.text: A doctor has told me I have a heart, blood-vessel, lung, kidney, or metabolic condition (such as diabetes).
options.basis: ACSM 2015 known CV/metabolic/renal disease; PAR-Q+ Q1/Q4 topics

options.text: Recently I have had chest pain or pressure, fainting, unusual shortness of breath, or dizziness with exertion.
A health professional has told me to exercise only with medical supervision or to limit my activity.
I am currently unwell (cold, fever) or recovering from surgery or a recent injury.
I am pregnant or recently gave birth.
options.basis: PAR-Q+ delay condition; ACOG CO 804; Mottola 2018

options.text: None of these.

questions.storage: store derived state + screen date only; do not store raw selections beyond what is needed to re-derive state; never free text

pause_and_refer.unlock: self-attested clearance by a health professional

gentle_path.allowed_intensity: light-to-moderate; talk test comfortable (full sentences); RPE <= somewhat hard
gentle_path.trials: non-maximal only (talk test, sit-to-rise if no limitation, 6-min walk at comfortable pace, chair stand)

vigorous_locked.trials: vigorous/maximal trials require explicit opt-in acknowledgment

acsm_2015_reference_logic.regular_exercise_definition: planned structured PA >= 30 min moderate on >= 3 d/wk for >= 3 months

rule.in_quest_safety: persistent 'I feel unwell' control ending the quest and showing stop-and-seek-care guidance

onboarding_questions.text: Which age range are you in?

mapping.under_18: route to separate guardian-consent flow (out of scope)

onboarding_questions.text: Which comparison table should we use? (Only used to compare your results with published norms.)

norms.prefer_not_to_say: average of male and female tables

onboarding_questions.text: Which best describes your usual activity over the last month?

options.text: I mostly avoid walking or physical effort.
Light activity only, like leisurely walks or taking the stairs.
Some moderate activity (e.g., brisk walking, yoga, easy cycling), about 10-60 minutes a week.
Moderate activity for more than an hour a week.
Some vigorous activity (e.g., running, hard cycling), under 30 minutes a week.
Vigorous activity about 30-60 minutes a week.
Vigorous activity about 1-3 hours a week.
Vigorous activity more than 3 hours a week.

mapping.PA_R: value (0-7), paraphrase of NASA/JSC Physical Activity Rating used by Jackson 1990
mapping.approx_mvpa_note: low-confidence conversion for WHO-band logic only

onboarding_questions.text: On how many days in a typical week do you do muscle-strengthening activity (weights, bodyweight exercises, resistance bands, heavy physical work)?
Which of these can you do today without much difficulty? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Walk for 30 minutes at a comfortable pace
Climb two flights of stairs without stopping
Get up from sitting on the floor without using my hands
Touch my toes with straight legs
Hold a plank or push-up position for 30 seconds
None of these right now

onboarding_questions.text: Anything we should work around? (Select all that apply. No details needed.)

options.text: Upper body (shoulder, elbow, wrist)
Lower body (hip, knee, ankle, foot)
Back or core
I prefer low-impact movement
Pregnant or recently gave birth
I use a mobility aid (cane, walker, crutches)
I use a wheelchair
Balance is a concern for me
None

onboarding_questions.storage: store chip ids only; editable any time

onboarding_questions.text: What do you want your quests to focus on? (Pick up to 2.)

mapping.note: avoid weight-loss framing; never collect weight

friend_2015_treadmill_percentiles.note: FRIEND 2022 update is 1.5-4.6 lower for treadmill; consider switching once table obtained

muscular_endurance.band5_requires: history chronic MVPA >= 450 min/wk or trial

primary.name: Jackson 1990 N-Ex BMI model with imputed reference BMI

bmi_imputation.rationale: App must not collect weight/height; substitute reference-population mean BMI by sex and age band (derived from FRIEND 2015 cohort mean height and weight)
bmi_imputation.unknown_sex: mean of male and female values
bmi_imputation.bias_warning: systematically overestimates VO2max for players with above-mean BMI; mitigated by conservative prescribed band

optional_hr_ratio_model.name: Uth heart-rate ratio method
optional_hr_ratio_model.input_source: resting HR from linked wearable only (never asked)

published_SEE.population: well-trained men n=36; women PF from n=27 trained

optional_hr_ratio_model.caveat: resting-based wearable estimates overestimate on average (+2.17, LoA -13.1 to +17.4); never unlock vigorous content on this alone

blend.method: inverse-variance weighted mean of available estimates
blend.precedence: device VO2max / history / trial estimates replace questionnaire estimate when their SE is smaller

alternatives_catalogue.name: Wier 2006 BMI
alternatives_catalogue.usable: only with imputed BMI and PASS wording (not verified)

hunt_pa_index_scoring.confidence: medium (from Nauman 2012 same HUNT group; exact Nes 2011 scoring unverified)

nonexercise_vo2max_model.change_tracking_warning: Non-exercise equations detect direction of fitness change correctly only ~56% of the time (median of 27 equations); do not use re-answered questionnaires to measure progress

optional_trials.protocol: Warm up 5-10 min; cover maximum distance in 12 minutes running/walking on flat ground; GPS distance.
Walk 1 mile (1609 m) as fast as possible on flat ground; record time and heart rate at finish (wearable).

scoring.weight_handling: impute FRIEND sex/age mean weight (male ~83-88 kg, female ~66-77 kg) or fall back to time-only bands

optional_trials.protocol: Walk back and forth on a measured flat loop for 6 minutes at your own fastest comfortable pace; rest allowed.

scoring.note: Enright reference equations require height and weight, so use medians + self-relative change

optional_trials.protocol: Maximum consecutive push-ups with good form, no rest; toes (standard) or knees (modified). Score each against its own table.

norms_csep_acsm.unverified_note: Non-verified rows recalled from ACSM/CSEP tables; replace from primary CSEP-PATH manual before use

optional_trials.context: Men >40 push-ups had IRR 0.04 (95% CI 0.01-0.36) for CVD events vs <10 (male firefighters)

optional_trials.protocol: From a standard-height chair, arms crossed, count full stands in 30 seconds.

norms_normal_range_25_75pct_age_60plus.note: Recalled Senior Fitness Test normal ranges; verify against Rikli & Jones primary source. Under 60: self-relative only.

optional_trials.band_rule: below range -> 2; within range -> 3; above range -> 4

optional_trials.protocol: From standing, sit down on the floor and stand back up using as little support as possible. Start with 5 points each for sitting and rising; subtract 1 for each hand, knee, forearm or leg-side support used and 0.5 for a noticeable loss of balance.
optional_trials.evidence: Ages 51-80: adjusted HR for mortality 5.44 (lowest vs highest category); each 1-point increase ~21% survival improvement

optional_trials.protocol: Seated, legs straight, feet against a box or step; reach forward slowly and hold 2 s. Home score = cm beyond toes + 26 (CSEP box zero at 26 cm); negative if short of toes.
Back against wall, knees ~90 degrees, hold as long as possible (stop at 3 min).
optional_trials.scoring: self-relative only: improvement vs personal best; no absolute band
optional_trials.note: No robust peer-reviewed adult norms found

optional_trials.protocol: During a gradually harder walk/jog/cycle, recite a short passage each few minutes; note when speaking first becomes uncertain (equivocal) and when it is no longer comfortable.

scoring.output: personal moderate ceiling = pace/HR at last comfortable stage; equivocal stage ~ ventilatory threshold

optional_trials.safety_tier: any (stop at first equivocal stage for gentle/prenatal paths)

gap_handling.action: apply R1 detraining decay before assigning bands

aerobic_priority.rule: median of latest 3 device estimates within 42 days

apple_bias_adjustment.note: Apple underestimated by ~6 in two small studies; mid applies half; review

aerobic_priority.note: Apple uses user's own profile weight internally; HealthRPG receives only the VO2max value

aerobic_priority.hrmax: max(208 - 0.7*age, observed max HR in history, excluding artifacts)

rules: best >= 3 km run -> race-performance VO2 estimate (Daniels; medium confidence)

muscular_strength_from_history.load_tracking: self-relative e1RM trend via Epley (load*(1+reps/30)); no relative strength (needs body mass)

mobility_from_history.rule: +0.5 band prior if >= 2 yoga/mobility sessions per week; otherwise rely on onboarding/trials

progression_guard.acwr: do not use as injury predictor (no causal support)

history_inference_rules.strava_fitness_note: Strava Fitness is an impulse-response training-load score (Relative Effort / power Training Load), not VO2max; use only for chronic load

labels.solid: device VO2max or history with >=6 sessions
labels.sharp: trial within 30 days or pace-HR fit r>=0.85

steps: age = age_midpoint; sex = model_sex_value; bmi = bmi_imputation[sex][age_band]
est_q = Jackson1990(PA_R, age, bmi, sex); se_q = total_se_with_imputation[sex].mid
if device resting HR: est_u = Uth(PF[sex], 208-0.7*age, RHR); blend inverse-variance
override with history/trial estimate when its SE is smaller
strength/endurance/mobility from activity_level_to_capacity_bands rules; history overrides
apply limitation filters; recalibrate after 2 weeks from quest RPE feedback
